## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-*juan* Northern-Sòng commemorative liturgy by **Zūnshì** 遵式 (964–1032) for the periodic monastic commemoration of [智顗](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E9%A1%97) Zhìyǐ (538–597), the founding patriarch of the Tiāntái school. The work belongs to the broader Tiāntái institutional commemorative tradition that developed around the school's founding figure.

**Abstract**

The *Zhāijì lǐzàn wén* provides the standard Sòng-period Tiāntái liturgical material for the *zhāijì* 齋忌 (fast-day commemoration) services held annually on the anniversary of Zhìyǐ's death. The composition is bracketed within Zūnshì's productive period at Tiānzhúsì in Hángzhōu, c. 996–1032.
